fusions.name: Over the Fence
fusions.desc: Fires a slow bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Enervated] for 5 seconds, its health, mana and stamina slow to return.

fusions.name: Lowered Horns
fusions.desc: You sweep your horns through a 3-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds, its Recovery drained.

fusions.name: Not to Be Hurried
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Slow to Anger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
